reason: This is not just a local Lightning cleanup: it appears to change user-variable support in `BuildSimpleExpr`, touching central expression/planner/session-variable code (`pkg/expression/expression.go`, `pkg/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go`, `pkg/sessionctx/variable/session.go`). User variables are SQL-semantic and session-scoped, so this can plausibly introduce high-severity correctness regressions in expression rewriting/evaluation beyond the importer path.
